title: Public Test Account Credential Exposure & Remediation
description: Public documentation and test scripts previously contained hardcoded plaintext credentials (Password123!) for buyer, seller, and admin test accounts.

remediationActions.details: Purged all active sessions and existing account hash records for target users in MongoDB Atlas; re-registered with rotated high-entropy password loaded strictly from TEST_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD.

remediationActions.action: Plaintext Password Removal from Tracked Files

remediationActions.details: Added TEST_BUYER_EMAIL, TEST_SELLER_EMAIL, TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL, and TEST_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD to .env.example with safe placeholders. Verified .env is strictly ignored in .gitignore.

gitHistoryAudit.backendRepositoryStatus: CLEAN (Zero commits contain exposed credentials in resell-hub-server)
gitHistoryAudit.recommendation: Perform a controlled Git history rewrite using git-filter-repo or BFG Repo-Cleaner on a backup branch, followed by an authorized force push with team notification. Do NOT force push automatically.
